articles.title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
articles.description: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

articles.title: EToro to buy TradeZero as Q2 crypto revenue falls 30%
articles.description: Trading platform eToro will acquire TradeZero as part of its US expansion as it reported crypto-related revenue fell by about 30% compared to the second quarter of 2025.

articles.title: Russia proposes exchange trading of Bitcoin, Ether and Tether’s USDT
